biggest_catch: The friend must register for the program first, then complete a $200+ deposit and 10 debit transactions within 60 days — the card arrives 4-6 weeks after requirements are met.
catches: Payout is a Visa Reward Card, not cash.
Reward card delivery takes 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed.
Cap: up to $500 per calendar year.
Minor checking accounts are not eligible.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Greater Texas Credit Union's official page (gtfcu.org/greater-texas-cu/why-us/refer-a-friend) runs a Refer-A-Friend program paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns a $50 Visa Reward Card for each friend who opens and uses a new Greater Texas or Aggieland Credit Union checking account, up to $500 per calendar year (i.e., 10 paid referrals).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: visit the referral site or call (629) 888-9043 to begin referring; the friend registers for the program, opens a new Greater Texas or Aggieland CU checking account, and within 60 days completes one deposit of $200 or more and ten debit card transactions (excluding ATM withdrawals).

c4.evidence: Timing: allow 4-6 weeks for delivery of the Reward Card after completing all requirements of the offer.

eligibility: Members 18 years or older of Greater Texas or Aggieland Credit Union; minor checking accounts are not eligible.
notes: Friend earns the same $50 Visa Reward Card. This is distinct from R0985 (the $250 new-account signup bonus).
numeric_basis: Per-referral reward of $50.00 Visa Reward Card.
payout_value_note: Visa Reward Card (gift card), not cash.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the official page.

s4.note: Cap: up to $500 per calendar year.

s5.note: Offer live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); terms available on request at local branches.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: visit the referral site or call (629) 888-9043 to begin referring.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: register for the program; open a new Greater Texas or Aggieland CU checking account; within 60 days complete one deposit of $200+ and ten debit card transactions (excluding ATM withdrawals).

steps: Begin referring via the Greater Texas CU referral site or by calling (629) 888-9043.
